$comment: Registered exceptions to Gate 170's rule that no external action pin
targets a deprecated Node.js runtime (node20 or older), enforced by
GitHub's runners force such an action onto Node.js 24 and annotate the
run with "Node.js 20 is deprecated", which the watchdog files as
runners drop it, these steps fail.
Every entry is STALE-CHECKED: a waiver for a pin that is no longer in
use, or whose runtime in action-runtime-pins.json is not deprecated,
fails the gate, so a waiver cannot outlive the bump it waits for. Each
cites the open issue that tracks the bump (Gate 124).
